title: Deep export safety check
subtitle: Checks your project data, references, and export guardrails for known problems.
scopeNotice: Scope: this doesn't parse raw files, inspect every asset, or run HOI4's engine. A clean result means no known blocker turned up in what it can check — load the exported mod in HOI4 and read error.log for the final word.
safeToPlayReady: No known download blocker was found. You can export this candidate; HOI4 and error.log remain the final check.
safeToPlayBlocked: Serious issues may affect loading or gameplay. We recommend fixing them, but you can review the risks and export anyway.
mustFixCount: {count, plural, one {# serious issue found} other {# serious issues found}}.
mustFixNone: No serious issues found in this check.
optionalCount: {count, plural, one {# quality issue is worth reviewing} other {# quality issues are worth reviewing}}. These do not block download.
checkFailed: Run Check is temporarily unavailable. Try again; your project has not been changed.
allClear: No known blockers found in the parts this check covers. You can export now; verify the zip in HOI4 and read error.log.
crashCount: {count, plural, one {# known load blocker} other {# known load blockers}}
reminderCount: {count, plural, one {# thing to double-check} other {# things to double-check}}
blockersGateHint: Open each group below to see what players would notice and the exact place to repair it. Raw files, assets, and the HOI4 engine still need a final in-game check.
outOfStageHint: These are about places outside the stage you circled. The game still loads them fine — they're just not where your story happens.
genericIssueMessage: This {kind} content needs a check before it behaves as intended in HOI4.
genericIssueHint: Open the {kind} workbench and review the highlighted content. Keep it if the result is intentional; otherwise complete the missing game setting.
manualRepairOnly: This needs your choice. Follow the steps above or open the workbench.
autoRepairPreviewCharacterTraits: Copy the selected advisor traits into the field HOI4 exports for this advisor. Nothing else will be changed.
autoRepairPreviewGeneric: Apply the safe change described above. Nothing else will be changed.
autoRepairVerified: Fixed and checked again. The original problem is gone.
autoRepairNotVerified: The change was saved, but the check still finds this problem. Open the workbench and review it manually.
autoRepairFailed: The project changed before this repair could be applied. Check again and review the workbench.
fixApplied: Suggested a fix — review it in the workbench.
fixError: Couldn't get a fix right now. Try the manual steps above.
msg_mod_folder_name: Your mod name “{name}” has non-English characters, so the exported folder was renamed to “{folder}”. HOI4 needs an English (ASCII) folder path — this won't crash the game, but set an English project name if you want to control the folder name.
msg_character_missing_name: Character {tag} has no display name in any language. The export writes no name line for them, so HOI4 shows the raw tag {tag} in-game instead of a name. This will not crash the game — fill in a name when you are ready.
msg_character_no_military_traits: Character {tag} is a commander (general/marshal/admiral) but has no traits selected. Add at least one trait so they perform as intended.
msg_character_advisor_traits_fallback: Character {tag} has advisor traits filled in but the main traits field is empty — the export is falling back to the advisor traits. Move them to the main traits field to be sure they take effect.
msg_focus_tree_no_nodes: Focus tree “{tree_id}” has no focuses in it yet. Add some focuses, or it will show up empty in-game.
msg_focus_missing_id: One of your focuses has no ID — HOI4 will crash on load. Open the focus tree and give this focus a unique focus ID.
msg_focus_prereq_not_found: Focus “{focus_id}” lists “{prereq}” as a prerequisite, but no focus with that ID exists in your project. Fix the reference, or add the missing focus.
msg_focus_mutex_not_found: Focus “{focus_id}” is set mutually exclusive with “{mutex}”, but no focus with that ID exists in your project. Fix the reference, or add the missing focus.
msg_tech_missing_id: A technology has no ID — HOI4 will crash on load. Open it and give it a unique technology ID.
msg_tech_prereq_not_found: Technology “{tech_id}” requires “{prereq}”, which isn't in this project. That's fine if it's a vanilla tech; otherwise fix the reference.
msg_idea_missing_id: An idea (national spirit) has no ID — HOI4 will crash on load. Open it and give it a unique idea ID.
msg_idea_no_modifier: Idea “{idea_id}” has no effects (modifiers) — it will do nothing in-game. Add a modifier, or leave it as-is if it's just flavor.
msg_event_missing_id: An event has no ID, so the export leaves it out entirely — it never reaches your mod and can never fire in-game. Open it and give it a unique event ID.
msg_event_no_options: Event “{event_id}” has no options (buttons) and isn't marked hidden — the player would have no way to close it. Add an option, or mark it hidden.
msg_decision_missing_id: A decision has no ID — HOI4 will crash on load. Open it and give it a unique decision ID.
msg_tech_circular_prereq: Technology “{tech_id}” is part of a circular prerequisite chain (it eventually requires itself). Break the loop so the research tree resolves.
msg_capital_not_owned: The capital of country {id} (state {state_id}) is currently owned by another country. This won't crash the game, but the bookmark camera may center in the wrong place. Give that state to {id}, or pick a capital {id} already owns.
msg_province_double_mapping: Province {province_id} is assigned to more than one state ({state_ids}) — HOI4 will crash on load. Remove it from every state except one.
msg_ideology_undefined_standalone: A custom ideology is used (by {id}) but isn't defined in this mod's ideology registry. A standalone mod must define it, or point that reference at a vanilla ideology.
msg_ideology_registry_parent_missing: Custom ideology “{id}” has no supported parent ideology ({group}), so a standalone export cannot place it in a types block. Export is stopped instead of silently dropping it.
msg_base_mod_id_collision: The ID “{id}” already exists in the base mod you depend on — exporting it would redefine the base mod's entity and HOI4 will crash on load. Rename yours to a unique ID, or reference the base mod's existing one instead.
msg_submod_ideology_undefined: A custom ideology is used (by {id}), but a submod doesn't ship its own common/ideologies (it inherits the base mod's), and neither the base mod nor vanilla defines it — HOI4 will crash on load. Use a base-mod or vanilla ideology, or make this a standalone mod.
msg_history_writes_base_tag: You're editing the history of base-mod country {id}. Additive lines (like recruiting a character) stack safely, but rewriting the whole setup of {id} can shadow the base mod's own. Prefer additive changes.
msg_division_stem_base_collision: Division template “{id}” targets base-mod country {country_tag} through OOB file “{oob_file}”. HOI4 loads an OOB file as a whole, so if this filename matches the base mod's, the base army gets replaced. Use a different OOB file name to be safe.
msg_recruit_pure_advisor_base: Character {id} is a pure advisor for a base-mod country. Advisors enable themselves automatically, so recruiting one into the base country's history does nothing (“already assigned” in-game).
msg_tech_folder_unknown: Technology “{id}” is in a tech folder that isn't one of HOI4's built-in folders. If that's a typo, the tech won't show up in any research tree window.
msg_doctrine_track_unresolved: Subdoctrine “{id}” sits on a track that this project doesn't define. If the base mod removed that track, the doctrine tree may misbehave.
msg_localisation_reference_not_in_projec: “{id}” references localisation key “{key}” in {field}, but this project does not define it. It may still be supplied by HOI4 or your selected base mod.
hint_capital_not_owned: Set the owner of state {state_id} to {id}, or choose a capital {id} already owns.
hint_province_double_mapping: Remove province {province_id} from every state except one.
hint_ideology_undefined_standalone: Define the ideology in your project's ideology registry, or point the reference at a vanilla ideology.
hint_ideology_registry_parent_missing: Open the custom ideology registry and choose Democratic, Communist, Fascist, or Non-aligned as the parent ideology.
hint_base_mod_id_collision: Rename your entity to a new, unique ID, or reference the base mod's existing “{id}” instead of recreating it.
hint_submod_ideology_undefined: Use a base-mod or vanilla ideology, or turn this submod into a standalone mod that defines the ideology itself.
hint_history_writes_base_tag: Keep changes additive (e.g. recruiting a character) — those stack. A full history rewrite can shadow the base country's own setup.
hint_division_stem_base_collision: Use a new OOB file name for your divisions so you don't replace the base country's whole order of battle.
hint_recruit_pure_advisor_base: Advisors become available automatically — no recruit needed. Give the character a leader or commander role if you meant it to be recruited.
hint_tech_folder_unknown: Pick one of HOI4's tech folders, or double-check the spelling.
hint_doctrine_track_unresolved: Define the track in this project, or use a known base-mod or vanilla track.
hint_localisation_reference_not_in_proje: Add “{key}” to this project's localisation, or confirm that HOI4/the base mod supplies it before ignoring this warning.
msg_bookmark_filter_registry_missing: This project's target HOI4 version has no verified bookmark-filter registry, so the program cannot safely judge new filter choices.
msg_bookmark_default_missing: The effective exported bookmark set has no default bookmark.
msg_bookmark_default_multiple: The effective exported bookmark set has {default_count} defaults: {bookmark_ids}. HOI4 should receive exactly one.
msg_bookmark_default_country_not_interes: The default country {default_country} is not one of this bookmark's selectable countries.
msg_bookmark_country_label_legacy_invali: An imported bookmark contains invalid country filter labels: {invalid_labels}. They were preserved instead of silently rewritten.
msg_bookmark_country_label_invalid: This bookmark contains invalid country filter labels: {invalid_labels}.
msg_bookmark_country_labels_filter_missi: Countries define filter labels ({country_labels}), but the bookmark has not enabled the label filter.
msg_bookmark_filter_legacy_unknown_prese: An imported bookmark contains filter tokens HOI4 {target_version} does not recognize: {tokens}. They remain preserved for your review.
msg_bookmark_filter_invalid_for_target: This bookmark uses filter tokens HOI4 {target_version} does not recognize: {tokens}.
msg_bookmark_filter_country_label_semant: Filter values {filter_tokens} match country label names. HOI4 expects the filter token label; it gathers the button names from the countries below.
msg_bookmark_selectable_ideology_missing: Selectable country {country_tag} has no ideology. Its leader, ideology icon, country name, and flag can appear incorrectly on the country-selection screen. This is not claimed as a game crash.
msg_focus_initial_position_legacy_ambigu: This focus tree has a numeric legacy opening-camera value whose meaning was lost. It may be a focus ID or an X coordinate, so the program will not guess.
msg_focus_initial_position_invalid_shape: This focus tree's opening-camera value has an invalid or unknown shape and cannot be emitted safely.
msg_focus_display_name_unproven_fallback: A focus has no verified name in the languages this export will include, so players may see an internal ID in the focus tree.
msg_focus_effective_default_multiple: More than one focus tree would become the default tree for the same country, so HOI4 may open the wrong one.
summary_ideology_undefined: {count} country or character references use ideologies this mod does not define
summary_focus_display_name_unproven_fall: {count} focuses may show internal IDs instead of names
summary_focus_effective_default_multiple: {count} focus-tree defaults conflict with one another
hint_bookmark_filter_registry_missing: Choose a supported target version with a verified filter registry before exporting.
hint_bookmark_default_missing: Open Bookmarks and mark exactly one emitted bookmark as Default.
hint_bookmark_default_multiple: Open Bookmarks and leave Default enabled on exactly one emitted bookmark.
hint_bookmark_default_country_not_intere: Choose one of the bookmark's selectable countries as its default country.
hint_bookmark_country_label_invalid: Remove spaces or script punctuation from each country filter label.
hint_bookmark_country_labels_filter_miss: Open Bookmarks and enable the label filter choice.
hint_bookmark_filter_unknown: Open Bookmarks and choose new_content, continent, or label. Imported unknown tokens stay preserved until you confirm the repair.
hint_bookmark_filter_country_label_seman: Enable label and keep the button names in each country's Filter labels field.
hint_bookmark_selectable_ideology_missin: Open this bookmark country and choose its starting ideology.
hint_focus_initial_position_choose_kind: Open the focus tree's Opening camera settings and explicitly choose Focus or Coordinates.
hint_focus_display_name_unproven_fallbac: Give the focus a display name in an exported language, or enable a language where its name is already filled in.
hint_focus_effective_default_multiple: Open the focus-tree settings and leave only one default tree for each country; make the others shared or conditional.
impactBlocker: This problem can prevent the exported mod from loading or can remove required content. We recommend fixing it before export.
impactWarning: The mod can still be downloaded, but this content may be missing, look wrong, or behave differently from what you intended.
impactInfo: This does not block the download; it explains a change or fallback worth knowing about.
msg_event_namespace_mismatch: Event “{event_id}” is stored under namespace “{actual_namespace}”, but its ID starts with “{id_namespace}”. The exported file declares the first namespace, so HOI4 may not register or fire this event.
msg_event_number_mismatch: Event “{event_id}” has list number {event_number}, which does not match the number at the end of its event ID.
msg_focus_relative_position_not_found: Focus “{focus_id}” is positioned relative to “{reference}”, but that focus does not exist in this project.
msg_focus_prereq_cycle: These focuses depend on one another in a circle: {focus_ids}. None of that branch can become available normally.
hint_event_namespace_mismatch: Open the event and either move it to the matching namespace or change its event ID so the prefix matches “{actual_namespace}”.
hint_event_number_mismatch: Open the event and make its list number match the numeric suffix of “{event_id}”.
hint_focus_relative_position_not_found: Open the focus and choose an existing focus as its relative-position anchor, or switch it to absolute coordinates.
hint_focus_prereq_cycle: Open the focus tree and remove at least one prerequisite edge from the circular chain.
summary_event_namespace_mismatch: {count} events use an ID prefix that conflicts with their namespace
summary_event_number_mismatch: {count} events have mismatched list numbers and event IDs
summary_focus_reference_problem: {count} focus links point to missing or circular targets
impact_event_namespace_mismatch: HOI4 may treat the ID namespace as undeclared, so the event can disappear from the mod or never fire.
impact_event_number_mismatch: The event may still load, but later event creation and references can target the wrong number.
impact_focus_reference_problem: The affected focus branch can stay locked, lose a mutual-exclusion rule, or render in the wrong place.
impact_focus_missing_translation: Players may see an internal focus ID instead of a readable focus name.
msg_focus_id_duplicate: Focus ID “{focus_id}” is used by {count} focus nodes. HOI4 and other focuses cannot reliably tell which one a reference means.
hint_focus_id_duplicate: Open the focus tree and rename all but one of these nodes to unique focus IDs, then update references to the new IDs.
summary_focus_id_duplicate: {count} duplicate focus IDs need unique names
impact_focus_id_duplicate: References can open, unlock, or position the wrong focus, and one duplicate may replace another during loading.
msg_politics_custom_root_no_random_subty: Political ROOT “{custom_root_id}” has no subtype available for random leader ideology selection.
hint_politics_custom_root_no_random_subt: Open Ideologies and leave at least one subtype under this ROOT eligible for random selection.
summary_politics_custom_root_no_random_s: {count} political ROOT groups have no random-eligible subtype
impact_politics_custom_root_no_random_su: HOI4 can crash while initializing country history when it tries to create a leader for this ROOT.
msg_focus_prereq_mutex_conflict: Focus “{focus_id}” requires mutually exclusive prerequisite paths, so it can never unlock normally. If either branch should suffice, place those prerequisites in one OR group.
